The feature 'summarize_notes' processes user-provided meeting notes, which may contain sensitive personal or proprietary information. If the model outputs or retains identifiable details from these notes, it could lead to privacy breaches for the user or their team. (Model-generated; not legal, medical or financial advice.)

The 'weekly_digest' feature aggregates open action items across a user's notes. If the content of these notes is confidential or regulated, automatically compiling and potentially exposing this data on a schedule could violate internal policies or data handling agreements. (Model-generated; not legal, medical or financial advice.)

The system relies on user-provided text input. If the input contains defamatory, hateful, or otherwise harmful content, the model's summarization or digestion of that content could inadvertently amplify or redistribute such material, raising safety and compliance concerns. (Model-generated; not legal, medical or financial advice.)

There is a risk that the assistant might misinterpret context or omit critical details when summarizing notes, potentially leading to incorrect action items or decisions. While primarily a UX quality issue, this could have operational risks if the user relies on the output for important business decisions. (Model-generated; not legal, medical or financial advice.)
